gen-gf-baumans-gf-roboto-serif: Letters like bent tubing, strange and sure of themselves, set the tone. Roboto Serif, classic and dignified with big open eyes and mild thick-thin shifts, gives that tubing a generously spaced companion.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sahitya: Stems like smooth dowels and arcs like bent ones give Baumans its unmistakable look. Sahitya, a classic serif whose thin strokes sit only slightly below the thick ones, supplies a bookish, moderate-contrast counterpoint.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Baumans draws every line as if traced with a single marker tip. Sawarabi Mincho underneath has a gentle ebb and flow of weight and trimmed terminals, a deliberate foil to that marker-tip heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sedan: Lines like toothpaste squeezed out in one steady stroke. Sedan would carry long paragraphs with a bookish, authoritative steadiness, its mellow weight changes tucked where the bowls curve around.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sedan-sc: Unshaded lines that never swell, plain and sure of themselves, lead the way. Sedan SC, a literary serif with broad open counters, supplies the soft heavy-to-light shading Baumans lacks entirely.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-shippori-mincho: Commanding by nature, Baumans keeps every stem and arc in lockstep and announces itself. Shippori Mincho, a serif with modest contrast and generous openings, does the opposite job, rewarding a closer look.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-shippori-mincho-b1: Distinctive in its single thick-thread line, Baumans meets a refined text serif whose strokes taper mildly through every bend. Shippori Mincho B1 supplies the editorial polish; the heading supplies the nerve.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-stix-two-text: STIX Two Text keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks. Under Baumans, whose o has a constant wall all the way round, long paragraphs would settle into a traditional, editorial rhythm.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Baumans keeps its strokes flat, with no shading at all. Tai Heritage Pro opens a clear channel into each round letter, so extended reading would feel steady, dignified and lightly varied in stroke.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-taviraj: Constant, unshaded strokes with an open, wrench-like c give Baumans a look that is hard to mistake. And Taviraj, with medium contrast and generous gaps where curves end, adds a mellow, bookish range beneath it.
